\mxunit{enrichment-telescoping-exercises}{Telescoping sums}
\mxsubtitle{High school · sequences \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 10}

\begin{exercise}
Find $\sum [\frac{1}{k}-\frac{1}{k+1}]$ from $k=3$ to 10.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Express $\frac{1}{k(k+2)}$ as a difference of two fractions.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Find $\sum (2k+1)$ from $k=0$ to n using $(k+1)^{2}-k^{2}$.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
If $S_{n}=\frac{n}{n+1}$, find the least integer $n\geq 1$ with $1-S_{n}<0.01$.
\end{exercise}
